source_snapshot.criteria: Train to expected width and speed with no Errors
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 30 attended and 180 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; assumes NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual and operator setup can exercise Gen2-to-Gen6.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; held Pending for positive Gen6 support, Speed Change 26, Gen2 start, complete evidence and recovery.

old_problem: A Gen6 tool option is not proof that the entire channel supports Gen6, and a counted transaction is invalid unless it independently starts at full-width Gen2. Unsupported forcing or final-state-only evidence could falsely satisfy the case.
disposition_reason: Source intent, direction, count and oracle are unambiguous. Positive Gen6 support, exact vendor primitive, topology, timing/error limits and recovery can be signed runtime prerequisites. If capability is absent, execution stays BLOCKED or becomes N/A only with authoritative SPEC; review need not remain Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2114, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2115 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00036-V002 / b2557c3f223b69a9 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Speed Change 26 uniquely requires 500 Gen2-to-Gen6 transitions at expected width/speed with no errors; no other start generation or Gen5 result is equivalent.
Require affirmative Gen6/full-width support for root port, switch, retimer, board/backplane, endpoint/GPU, firmware and pinned LTSSM/NVQual operation.
For every numbered cycle prove Gen2/full-width entry before capturing Gen6 request, equalization/LTSSM, settle deadline, target width/speed, enumeration and new error/health deltas.
Absent capability means execution BLOCKED; only project SPEC can justify N/A. Never force an exposed value or downgrade the target.
Count only 500 complete chronological records; stop before the next request on unsupported mode, wrong start, failed/late/downtrained target, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or evidence gap.
Preserve first-fault evidence, do not clear or retry automatically, and recover only by signed procedure.
No capability probe, LTSSM/NVQual, speed force/change, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Qualify five hundred genuine full-width Gen2-to-Gen6 transitions on the mapped path after authoritative full-channel Gen6 support is proven.
required_package: Authoritative Gen6/full-width capability evidence for all path elements and firmware
Pinned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 26 build, command and configuration
Approved per-cycle Gen2 entry and Gen6 equalization/LTSSM/settle/error rules
Dedicated SUT, 500-entry durable ledger/interlock, stable power/cooling, console and recovery
test_case.test_command: DO NOT FORCE OR EXECUTE until Project Configuration certifies end-to-end Gen6/full-width support and binds Speed Change 26. After point approval preserve baselines and execute entries 1..500, proving Gen2/full width before each request and recording Gen6 request, equalization/LTSSM, settled speed/width, enumeration, errors and health before the next entry. Stop on first unsupported state, fault or gap; do not clear, downgrade or retry.
test_case.expected_result: With capability proven, all 500 entries independently show full-width Gen2 start and Gen6 settle within the signed envelope, required devices present, no disqualifying new PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error and approved final health. Without capability, execution is BLOCKED.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until positive Gen6 capability, tool/path, Gen2-start method and limits are approved. PASS requires 500 complete accepted Gen2-to-Gen6 records. FAIL on force/mismatch, wrong start, failed/late/downtrained/reduced target, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or recovery failure. Missing capability/input/artifact is BLOCKED; N/A needs SPEC.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED without component-by-component Gen6/full-width proof.
Never force, downgrade or count a cycle without proven Gen2 entry.
Use the approved primitive only on an isolated SUT with console, stable power/cooling and point authorization.
Preserve first-fault evidence and stop without automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and Gen6 capability matrix
Pinned Speed Change 26 tool/configuration and topology/lane/firmware map
Gen2-start plus Gen6 equalization/full-width/deadline/error contract and baseline
Ledger 1..500 with raw start, request, LTSSM/equalization, settled Gen6/width, enumeration, timestamps and result
Per-cycle AER/kernel/GPU/BMC/thermal/power correlation and completeness audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final state, no-force/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unsupported indication, invalid Gen2 entry, failed/late/downtrained Gen6, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or artifact gap, inhibit all later requests and preserve the first event. Do not force, downgrade or retry; follow signed recovery and quarantine if topology/health is not restored.

source_conflict.reason: Source and reviews consistently specify Gen2-to-Gen6; feasibility is project capability data, not a conflicting requirement.

blocked.reason: The review method is complete. Runtime remains conditionally BLOCKED until positive capability and project bindings exist.

pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; POSITIVE GEN6 CAPABILITY GATE CLOSED; NO CAPABILITY PROBE, LTSSM/NVQUAL, SPEED FORCE/CHANGE, PCIE QUERY, RECOVERY, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: GB-NV-PVP PCIe/NVIDIA qualification and platform owners
pending.unlock_condition: Bind authoritative Gen6 capability and project inputs, then receive point authorization; absent support, keep execution BLOCKED or use N/A only with SPEC.

external_authorities.application: Permits parameterized review while requiring positive feature support, direct evidence, recovery and no unsupported forcing or retry.
